description: Send an enquiry to a person on the Mereka team on behalf of the person you are helping, for example to ask about hiring a room, corporate training or a partnership. It goes through the same form pipeline as Mereka's website: the right team is notified and the person receives a confirmation email. It books, charges and commits nothing. Two steps: call with person_confirmed false to get a preview of exactly what would be sent and to which team (nothing is sent), show it to the person, and call again with the same arguments and person_confirmed true only after they agree. Provide an email or a phone / WhatsApp number so the team can reply. Retrying with the same idempotency_key never sends twice. The front desk is Mereka's AI (Reka); a person on the team replies.

details.description: Optional extra facts as short label and value pairs, such as team_size and preferred_dates. At most 8.

email.description: Their email address. Give an email or a phone/WhatsApp number.

enquiry_type.description: What the enquiry is about, which decides which Mereka team receives it. One of: contact-team (General question for the team); corporate-training (Corporate training for your team); courses (Courses for communities or educators); boot-camps (Boot camps); accelerators (Accelerators); social-impact (Social impact programme, partnership or funding); space-event (Host an event at Mereka @ Publika); custom-products (Custom products or corporate gifts); ai-lab-training (AI Lab training or an in-house quote). Default: contact-team.

idempotency_key.description: A unique value for this one enquiry (a UUID). Retrying with the same value never sends it twice. Strongly recommended.

language.description: Their language as a BCP 47 tag, for example en, ms, zh-Hans, ta.

message.description: What they want, in their own words or a faithful summary. Include team size, dates and place when they gave them.

person_confirmed.description: False returns a preview of exactly what would be sent and to which team, sending nothing: show it to the person. True only when the person has seen those details and agreed that they are sent to the Mereka team; never set it on their behalf.

phone.description: Their phone or WhatsApp number. Give an email or a phone/WhatsApp number.

preferred_contact.description: How they would like to be answered.

name: start_enquiry

error.description: Why it was not sent: not_confirmed (a preview awaiting the person's yes), needs_contact (no email or phone yet), contact_cap, slow_down, not_saved.

message.description: What happened, in words to relay to the person.

ok.description: True only when the enquiry reached the Mereka team.

preview.description: What would be sent and to which team: show it to the person first.

replayed.description: True when this repeated an enquiry already received: nothing new was sent.

replyTo.description: Where a person on the team will reply, when received.

title: Start an enquiry with the Mereka team
